title: Ada Twist, Scientist
overview: Pint-sized scientist Ada Twist and her two best friends are asking big questions — and working together to discover the truth about everything!

title: Carmen Sandiego
overview: A master thief who uses her skills for good, Carmen Sandiego travels the world foiling V.I.L.E.'s evil plans — with help from her savvy sidekicks.

title: Dew Drop Diaries
overview: From finding lost items to cleaning up messes, three fairies in training love looking after kids in their care as they work toward earning their wings.

title: Emily's Wonder Lab
overview: Science-loving host Emily Calandrelli makes STEAM fun with activities, demonstrations and at-home experiments that'll make you think — and blow your mind!

title: Find Me in Paris
overview: When Lena Grisky, a Russian Princess and student at the Paris Opera Ballet School accidentally time travels to present day, she must quickly adapt if she hopes to keep her secret and hide from the dangerous Time Collectors.

title: Gymnastics Academy: A Second Chance
overview: Kyra Berry, a 14 year old USA gymnast arrives in Australia to try and win a scholarship at an elite Gymnastics Academy. It's a second chance but also her last.

title: H2O: Just Add Water
overview: H2O: Just Add Water revolves around three teenage girls facing everyday teen problems with an added twist: they cope with the burden of growing a giant fin and transforming into mermaids whenever they come in contact with water.

title: Hilda
overview: Fearless, free-spirited Hilda finds new friends, adventure and magical creatures when she leaves her enchanted forest home and journeys to the city.

title: I Woke Up a Vampire
overview: On her 13th birthday, Carmie discovers that she's actually half human, half vampire — and that mythical powers make middle school way more complicated.

title: Izzy's Koala World
overview: Young koala caretaker Izzy Bee and her family rescue cuddly creatures in need and help them head back into the wild on Australia’s Magnetic Island.

title: Julie and the Phantoms
overview: Teenage Julie finds her passion for music and life while helping the Phantoms -- a trio of ghostly guys -- become the band they were never able to be.

title: Kitti Katz
overview: Three teenage girls transform into fierce feline superheroes to save the world from an evil Egyptian goddess — and still have time for soccer practice.

title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight
overview: Follow the adventures of Po, who partners up with a no-nonsense English knight named Wandering Blade to find a collection of four powerful weapons before a mysterious pair of weasels do, and save the world from destruction.

title: Maya and the Three
overview: A spirited princess with the heart of a warrior embarks on a mission to fulfill an ancient prophecy and save humanity from the wrath of vengeful gods.

title: My Little Pony: Make Your Mark
overview: Welcome back to Equestria, where pony magic is everywhere. With friends Zipp, Sunny, Izzy, Pipp and Hitch leading the way, adventure is sure to follow!

title: Nailed It!
overview: Home bakers with a terrible track record take a crack at re-creating edible masterpieces for a $10,000 prize. It's part reality contest, part hot mess.

title: No Good Nick
overview: A family finds their lives turned upside down when a young, street-smart grifter shows up on their doorstep, claiming to be a distant relative.

title: Princess Power
overview: Princess friends from four different Fruitdoms — Blueberry, Kiwi, Pineapple and Raspberry — spring into action to make their worlds a better place.

title: Scaredy Cats
overview: On Willa Ward’s twelfth birthday, she inherits a beautiful charm necklace that belonged to her mother, who was a witch.  She soon learns 2 bad witches, Wilma and Wanda are after her locket so they can have ultimate power, and she alongside her best friends Scout and Lily turn into cats to escape.

title: Spirit Riding Free: Pony Tales
overview: Find the fun and adventure of "Spirit Riding Free" in this mix of music videos and short episodes featuring Lucky and all of her friends!

title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy
overview: In a small Western town a young girl from the city forms a tight bond with wild horse Spirit while having adventures with her friends.

title: Strawberry Shortcake: Berry in the Big City
overview: Aspiring baker Strawberry Shortcake arrives in Big Apple City to get her big break — and have flan-tastic adventures with her new berry besties!

title: Surviving Summer
overview: Rebellious Brooklyn teen Summer Torres is sent to live with family friends in the tiny town of Shorehaven on the Great Ocean Road, Victoria, AUS. Despite her best efforts, Summer falls in love with the town, the people and the surf.

title: The Baby-Sitters Club
overview: In this contemporary take on the beloved book series, five best friends launch a baby-sitting business that's big on fun and adventure.

title: The Worst Witch
overview: Mayhem and mishaps follow young witch Mildred Hubble wherever she goes. She just can't help it! But with her friends' help, Mildred always manages to avoid disaster just in time.

title: Trolls Holiday
overview: When the eternally optimistic Poppy, queen of the Trolls, learns that the Bergens no longer have any holidays on their calendar, she enlists the help of Branch and the rest of the gang on a delightfully quirky mission to fix something that the Bergens don't think is broken.

title: True and the Rainbow Kingdom
overview: When something's wrong in the Rainbow Kingdom, bighearted guardian True and her best friend, Bartleby, are there to grant wishes and save the day.

title: Victorious
overview: Aspiring singer Tori Vega navigates life while attending a performing arts high school called Hollywood Arts.

title: World of Winx
overview: The Winx travel all over the world searching for talent for WOW. and preventing the mysterious talent thief from kidnapping them.

title: Masters of the Universe: Revelation
overview: The war for Eternia begins again in what may be the final battle between He-Man and Skeletor. A new animated series from writer-director Kevin Smith.

title: Luz: The Light of the Heart
overview: Raised by a kind Kaingang family, adventurous young schoolgirl Luz launches a quest with her firefly companion to learn the truth about her roots.

title: Holly Hobbie
overview: Holly's a 13-year-old singer-songwriter who's got her best friends and close-knit family by her side, but she's dreaming of ways to save the world - even if it's starting in her own backyard.

title: Rebel Cheer Squad: A Get Even Series
overview: The old DGM might have left Bannerman School, but their spirit remains, and there is still a need to get even, wrongs must be righted and injustice has to be fought.

title: Dino Girl Gauko
overview: When she gets angry, middle schooler Naoko turns into fierce dinosaur Gauko! Thanks to friends, aliens and more, her life is full of wacky incidents.

title: Eden
overview: Thousands of years in the future, a city known as "Eden 3" is inhabited solely by robots whose former masters vanished a long time ago. On a routine assignment, two farming robots accidentally awaken a human baby girl from stasis questioning all they were taught to believe -- that humans were nothing more than a forbidden ancient myth. Together, the two robots secretly raise the child in a safe haven outside Eden.

title: Geek Girl
overview: Awkward teen Harriet has always wanted to fit in. Until she gets scouted by a top London model agent and learns that some people are meant to stand out.

title: Get Even
overview: On the surface Kitty, Margot, Bree and Olivia appear to have nothing in common - but there’s one passion which unites them: to expose injustice. They form their own secret society, DGM - they Don’t Get Mad, they Get Even - playing anonymous pranks to expose bullies.

title: Luna Petunia
overview: Luna Petunia follows the adventures of a girl who lives in our world and plays in a dreamland where she learns how to make the impossible possible.

title: ONI: Thunder God's Tale
overview: In a mystical world of Japanese gods and spirits, a courageous girl strives to follow in her mysterious father's footsteps and find her true powers.

title: Super Giant Robot Brothers
overview: Once the squabbling stops, the battling begins! Robot siblings Shiny and Thunder and their whiz inventor must defend Earth when space monsters attack.

title: The Big Nailed It Baking Challenge
overview: In this high-stakes "Nailed It!" spinoff competition, 10 novice bakers pick up tips from professional coaches while vying for a sweet cash prize.
